revision.description: Bumped by every change made through apply/undo

oneOf.description: One string per language code, e.g. { "en": "…", "es": "…" }

lang.description: Language of everything made from this circuit: drawing labels, the page, messages. A language asked for explicitly (--lang, MCP lang) wins.

spec.description: What layout was asked for, kept so the circuit can be laid out again (layout on an existing target) and so review can check the connections: nets of pin references, supplies that name pins, and the ids of the jumpers layout added

wires.description: jumpers added by layout (not parts of the spec)

recipe.description: The recipe the circuit was laid out from (src/recipes/), with the values given; gone once it is laid out again with other parts or nets

environment.description: The world the sensors read (docs/en/environment.md), shared by every part that senses a field: a number, or { value, program }. A part's own value ("light": 50 on the part) wins over it

light.description: lx, 0.1…10000 on the slider, 0…1000000 at most, default 300

program.description: Changes the field with simulated time: toggle, cycle, ramp, keyframes

shape.description: a signal generator's: sine starts in the middle rising, square high first, triangle at the bottom (default sine)

oneOf.description: from → to in `seconds`, then holds `to`

points.description: [[t, value], …], t in s going up: straight lines between them, the last one held

loop.description: start again after the last point

range.description: [min, max]: the span the slider and the indicator show (inside 0…1000000, min < max, min above 0); default 0.1…10000

supplies.description: Simulation: where the power comes from, besides battery parts. The first supply's negative is ground (0 V); with none, the first battery part's.

kind.description: battery: like a battery part (format, chemistry, cells, charge), or only a voltage (0.25 Ω per 1.5 V cell unless given); generator: a signal generator (waveform, frequency, amplitude, offset, resistance)

amplitude.description: generator: peak volts (half of peak to peak), default 1

positive.description: hole or node of the + lead, default "T+"

negative.description: hole or node of the − lead, default "T-"

currentLimit.description: bench supply current limit, amperes (constant current above it)

simulation.description: false: no simulation in the page at all (a value the learner must predict first). By default a circuit with a source gets it

results.description: Simulation results always on in the page (default: true with a source): the tapped part shows its values on the board and in its card, its oscilloscope and limits; LEDs light up. false turns them off

flow.description: The current layer as a button in the bar, not pressed (default: true with a source): everything dimmed, conductors coloured by voltage, moving dots. false leaves it out; { style } keeps it and chooses how it is drawn: 'plan' (default: at board level, a pad at every landing, a line through two-pin parts and jumpers, a stub per pin on the others) or 'real' (along the leads and through the bodies)

focus.description: Parts in focus when the page opens (the ones being explained)

controls.description: Live page: a panel with the controls a lesson puts in front (every adjustable part also has its own in its card). Each names a part or a supply and one of its controls: resistance (resistor), temperature (thermistor), light (photoresistor), position (potentiometer), pressed (push button, momentary), voltage (bench supply), charge (battery), frequency and amplitude (signal generator), threshold and its own stimulus (sensor-module)

supply.description: id of a supply (a drawn battery: use part)

environment.description: a field of the circuit's environment (instead of part or supply and field), shown with its indicator in the panel's Environment section

min.description: slider start, in the unit of the field (ohms, °C, lux, 0…1, volts)

environment.description: The whole environment (every field it has) in the side panel, each with its indicator and, for a field a program moves, Pause and Resume (default: true when a part follows a field of it)

theme.description: Colours of the page: 'auto' follows the system (default); 'light' or 'dark' (the bench), 'notebook' (cream paper, a blue grid) or 'stage' (the notebook at night, the videos') fix them. The reader's choice in the page's menu and a link's ?theme= win over this

tour.description: The timeline the page plays as *See how it works* (and a video is made from): the name of a JSON file beside the circuit (timeline.schema.json), read only from its folder, or the timeline itself

focusView.description: A part's view up close (the live page): the card of a part offers it, and the part goes alone on its pedestal with its pins, bench, symbol and inside view a tap away (default false)

start.description: Live simulation (with results or flow): 'dc' opens at the DC values (default); 'zero' switches on at t = 0 with capacitors discharged and runs

pins.description: Holes for the leads: a list in the part's pin order, or an object by pin name. Holes: a1…j63 (a1…t63 on a double board), rails T+3, B-12… (U+3 on a double board)

voltage.description: electrolytic: rated volts; battery: measured open-circuit volts (wins over charge)

part.description: Part number for diode, zener, bridge, mosfet, bjt, ic, regulator, ldr, seven-segment (5161AS common cathode, 5161BS common anode), slide-switch (SS12D00G3), tilt-switch (SW520D), temperature-sensor (LM35DZ default, LM35CZ), relay (SRD-05VDC-SL-C), motor (RE-140RA-12240 default, RE-140RA-2270), sensor-module (MH-RD, YL-69, LDR-LM393, SLOT-IR, TCRT5000-M, KY-024, SW-420-M, FC-51), rotary-encoder (KY-040), laser (KY-008, the default), ultrasonic-sensor (HC-SR04, the default, KY-037), hall-sensor (KY-035 default, 49E), voltage-sensor (VOLT-25V), buzzer (TMB12A05: the active one; without it, the passive) (see src/parts/db.js); module: ESP32-DEVKIT, ESP32-C3-SUPERMINI, UNO (see src/parts/modules.js)

style.description: wire: "arc" | "flat"; potentiometer: "knob" (default) | "trimmer" (multi-turn 3296W); switch: "rocker" (KCD1, default) | "latching" (7 × 7 push button)

pin1.description: DIP chips: hole of pin 1 (row e or f); the other pins follow. Header: first pin, the others towards higher columns. Module straddling the channel (ESP32): hole of pin 1, the other row rowSpacing holes away. Seven-segment display: hole of pin 1 (rows b–e, or f–i turned round), the other row 6 holes away (0.6") across the channel

rowSpacing.description: module (ESP32 boards): holes between its two rows of pins; boards differ (DevKit default 9 = 0.9")

wires.description: module UNO, switch, relay: colour of the lead of each pin, e.g. { "D13": "yellow" }

rese.description: module DESPI-C02: position of its RESE switch, ohms ("2.2" as sold, "0.47" for some panels)

panel.description: module DESPI-C02: also draw the 7.5" GDEY075T7 panel on its flat cable

io.description: module, microcontroller boards (ESP32 DevKit, ESP32-C3 SuperMini, UNO): the state of each GPIO for the simulation, by printed name, GPIO name or number ({"D13": "high", "D27": "input_pullup"}); unlisted pins are inputs (docs/en/microcontrollers.md)

program.description: module, microcontroller boards: its program for the simulation, the Arduino C++ subset a lesson uses: the sketch's text, or the name of a .ino file beside the circuit ("blink.ino"). setup() once, then loop(); delay() waits in simulated time (docs/en/microcontrollers.md)

usb.description: module, microcontroller boards: powered by USB (default true): the board is a 5 V source and its regulator makes the 3.3 V rail

common.description: rgb-led: the common pin (COM, the longest lead) is the chips' cathode (default) or their anode

led.description: regulator module (AMS1117): its power LED's resistor, "1k" (default), "200", or "none"

pressed.description: button state; rotary-encoder: its push switch is held down

on.description: switch: on (rocker on I, latching button down); default off

slid.description: slide-switch: the knob slid over to pin 2's side (COM joined to 2); default false (COM joined to 1)

tilted.description: tilt-switch: tipped over past its angle (open); default false (upright, closed)

load.description: motor: a load on its shaft in mN·m, against its turning (default 0); over its stall torque it holds the shaft still

chemistry.description: battery: default by format (AA/AAA alkaline, 18650 li-ion, pouch lipo)

cells.description: battery: cells (or 9 V blocks) in series; voltages add up

charge.description: battery: state of charge, 0 empty … 1 full; without it, the nominal voltage

capacity.description: battery: "2000 mAh" (a number is mAh); default by format

internalResistance.description: battery: ohms, for the whole pack

switch.description: battery: a holder with a slide switch, and its position

side.description: battery: board edge it lies beside (default: the nearer side edge); module UNO: back (default) or front; switch, relay: front (default) or back; motor: as a battery

offset.description: battery, module UNO, switch, relay, motor: shift along that edge, mm

count.description: header: number of pins (place with pin1)

temperature.description: thermistor, temperature-sensor (LM35): °C for the simulation (default 25); ultrasonic-sensor: the air's, which sets the speed of sound (default 20)

light.description: ldr: illuminance in lux for the simulation (default 100). Parts: GL5516, GL5528, GL5537, GL5539, GL5549. sensor-module LDR-LM393: its own light, which wins over the environment's

delay.description: pir-sensor: seconds OUT stays high after motion (the trimmer Tx; default 5)

sensitivity.description: pir-sensor: the sensitivity trimmer, 0…1 (default 0.5; the model has no range, so it only shows)

mode.description: pir-sensor: "H" (default) motion during OUT high starts the delay again, "L" ignores it; touch-sensor: "momentary" (default) SIG follows the touch, "toggle" each touch flips it

warmup.description: pir-sensor: seconds after power on with OUT low and motion ignored (default 30; 0 skips it)

motion.description: pir-sensor: its own value of the environment field motion (a part that gives it does not follow the environment)

activeLow.description: touch-sensor: SIG low while touched (or while a toggle is on); default false

fast.description: touch-sensor: the 60 ms response instead of the 220 ms low-power one; default false

touch.description: touch-sensor: its own value of the environment field touch

oneOf.description: One string per language code, e.g. { "en": "…", "es": "…" }

description.description: How the part is used in this circuit, shown in its card in the page. A plain string is shown as it is in every language; { "en": …, "es": … } is shown in the page language. Leave it out when the learner should find it out.

threshold.description: sensor-module: its trimmer, Vref = threshold · VCC (default 0.5); DO goes low while AO is under Vref

wetness.description: sensor-module MH-RD: its own share of the comb wet (0 dry … 1 all wet), instead of the environment's rain

moisture.description: sensor-module YL-69: its own soil moisture, %, instead of the environment's

beam.description: sensor-module SLOT-IR: its own beam, true (1) = something opaque in the slot, instead of the environment's

reflectance.description: sensor-module TCRT5000-M, FC-51: its own surface, % of white paper's reflectance (black ink 10), instead of the environment's

distance.description: sensor-module TCRT5000-M, FC-51, ultrasonic-sensor: its own distance to the surface or the object, cm, instead of the environment's

field.description: sensor-module KY-024, hall-sensor: its own magnetic field, G (+ a south pole at its face), instead of the environment's

sound.description: sensor-module KY-037: its own sound level, dB SPL, instead of the environment's

vibration.description: sensor-module SW-420-M: its own vibration, true (1) = shaken, instead of the environment's

transmittance.description: sensor-module SLOT-IR: what reaches the receiver through the slot with the beam clear (default 1; paper about 0.3)

pulses.description: rotary-encoder: pulses a turn; only 20 (the usual KY-040) is modelled

detents.description: rotary-encoder: clicks a turn; only 20 (the usual KY-040) is modelled

speed.description: rotary-encoder: degrees a second the shaft follows its target (default 360)

bounce.description: rotary-encoder: milliseconds of chatter at each change of CLK and DT, deterministic (default 0)

swPullup.description: rotary-encoder: the 10 kΩ from + to SW is on the module (default true; some clones omit it)

angle.description: rotary-encoder: its own target angle, degrees (snapped to the nearest click), instead of the environment's

slots.description: sensor-module SLOT-IR: an encoder disc with this many slots, turned by the environment's angle

duty.description: sensor-module SLOT-IR with slots: the open share of each slot (default 0.5)

seed.description: sensor-module SW-420-M: the pattern of its chatter (default: from its id)

model.description: Simulation: overrides the typical model, e.g. an LED measured at 20 mA { "vf": 2.95 } (see src/sim/models.js)
